propose.justification: New tool class emerged this week: git-native AI code attribution. At least 4 distinct repos (mesa-dot-dev/agentblame, sunilmallya/agentdiff, git-ai-project/git-ai, Ekaanth/blameprompt) all solving 'git blame for AI agents' with git notes. HN thread https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47510254 with strong engagement. No existing query covers this tool class.

Multi-agent harness is now a distinct tool class distinct from individual skills or MCPs. At least 6 repos found this week: mvschwarz/openrig (Show HN https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47772935), OpenSource03/harnss (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47635188), revfactory/harness, HKUDS/OpenHarness, Chachamaru127/claude-code-harness, affaan-m/everything-claude-code. Growing vocabulary: 'rig', 'harness', 'agent topology'.

HN thread https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47185250 ('OK, lets survey how everybody is sandboxing AI coding agents in early 2026') shows a live community need. Found repos: rsh3khar/claude-sandbox, tintinweb/claude-code-container, nikvdp/cco, textcortex/claude-code-sandbox (archived but spawned successors). Active 2026 HN discussion on containerization approaches.

Persistent memory for Claude Code is now a distinct plugin category with 4+ repos: thedotmack/claude-mem (46.1K stars, viral on Twitter), itsjwill/claude-memory, supermemoryai/claude-supermemory, coleam00/claude-memory-compiler. Active on HN https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45619537 and trending on X in April 2026.

Windsurf-native skills collections are emerging as a distinct category separate from Claude Code skills. Found falconnt/windsurf-skills with cross-compatibility analysis showing 86% of Claude Code skills adapted for Windsurf. Skills spec diverging from Cursor's .mdc rules and Claude's SKILL.md. No existing query specifically targets Windsurf platform.
